query:
INSERT INTO "LiteLLM_DailyEndUserSpend" (id, end_user_id, date, api_key, model,
                       custom_llm_provider, mcp_namespaced_tool_name, endpoint, model_group,
                       prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, api_requests, successful_requests,
                       failed_requests, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens,
                       total_response_time_ms, timed_requests, spend, updated_at)
                   SELECT gen_random_uuid()::text, r.entity_id, r.date, r.api_key, r.model,
                          r.custom_llm_provider, '', r.endpoint, r.model_group, r.prompt_tokens,
                          r.completion_tokens, r.api_requests, r.successful_requests,
                          r.failed_requests, r.cache_read, r.cache_creation, r.response_time,
                          r.timed_requests, r.spend, (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
                   FROM UNNEST($1::text[], $2::text[], $3::text[], $4::text[], $5::text[],
                               $6::text[], $7::text[], $8::int8[], $9::int8[], $10::int8[],
                               $11::int8[], $12::int8[], $13::int8[], $14::int8[], $15::int8[],
                               $16::int8[], $17::float8[])
                        AS r(entity_id, date, api_key, model, custom_llm_provider, endpoint,
                             model_group, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, api_requests,
                             successful_requests, failed_requests, cache_read, cache_creation,
                             response_time, timed_requests, spend)
                   ORDER BY r.date, r.entity_id, r.api_key, r.model, r.custom_llm_provider
                   ON CONFLICT (end_user_id, date, api_key, model, custom_llm_provider,
                                mcp_namespaced_tool_name, endpoint) DO UPDATE SET
                       prompt_tokens = "LiteLLM_DailyEndUserSpend".prompt_tokens + EXCLUDED.prompt_tokens,
                       completion_tokens = "LiteLLM_DailyEndUserSpend".completion_tokens + EXCLUDED.completion_tokens,
                       api_requests = "LiteLLM_DailyEndUserSpend".api_requests + EXCLUDED.api_requests,
                       successful_requests = "LiteLLM_DailyEndUserSpend".successful_requests + EXCLUDED.successful_requests,
                       failed_requests = "LiteLLM_DailyEndUserSpend".failed_requests + EXCLUDED.failed_requests,
                       cache_read_input_tokens = "LiteLLM_DailyEndUserSpend".cache_read_input_tokens + EXCLUDED.cache_read_input_tokens,
                       cache_creation_input_tokens = "LiteLLM_DailyEndUserSpend".cache_creation_input_tokens + EXCLUDED.cache_creation_input_tokens,
                       total_response_time_ms = "LiteLLM_DailyEndUserSpend".total_response_time_ms + EXCLUDED.total_response_time_ms,
                       timed_requests = "LiteLLM_DailyEndUserSpend".timed_requests + EXCLUDED.timed_requests,
                       spend = "LiteLLM_DailyEndUserSpend".spend + EXCLUDED.spend,
                       updated_at = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
